data.body: AC1 non-codebase evidence: the merged commit message for 1798b4429135be7597669622e0fbaf82d441757b records the same-host before/after latency harness results: show_ticket(alias) improved from 7.6-17.8s to 0.166s on the real store, and the ticket RCA records the earlier observed 41.7s/39.9s idle measurements on the full store. This measurement evidence lives in the ticket/commit record rather than as a deterministic repository test; repository coverage for parse-free warm resolution is tests/unit/test_single_id_alias_resolve_scan_cache.py.
